$description: Checkbox, radio and switch. One token set because they are the same control with a different shape — 2.x split them across `form-check`, `form-switch` and `form-check-input`, which meant the sizes drifted apart. One ACCENT per validity state rather than a separate border colour for checked, hover, valid and invalid: the four had to be kept in step by hand, and a checked-and-invalid control ended up filled with the checked colour and outlined in the invalid one.

switch-thumb-on-color.$description: The thumb once the track is filled. Reads the role's ON colour rather than a literal white, so it follows the theme — in dark mode the filled track is lighter and a white thumb would sit on it at barely any contrast. `primary`, `danger` and `success` share the same on-colour in each mode, so one token covers every tone the switch can take.
